glasses_felix: Extremely volatile and unpredictable. Day 23 09:35 was bathroom_shelf_ba1 (missed by predicting coffee_table_l1); Day 23 10:26 was coffee_table_l1 (missed by predicting bathroom_shelf_ba1). Previous notes suggested checking desk_b1, coffee_table_l1, and bathroom_shelf_ba1. The rapid switching between these two spots within an hour indicates no stable pattern. Do not assume a single spot. Check coffee_table_l1, bathroom_shelf_ba1, and desk_b1.

tablet_felix: Highly volatile and context-dependent. Day 23 18:36 was kitchen_table_k1 (missed by predicting coffee_table_l1). Day 22 09:38 was coffee_table_l1; Day 22 17:38 was kitchen_table_k1. Previous notes suggested checking coffee_table_l1, kitchen_table_k1, and floor_k_k1. The 18:36 miss confirms kitchen_table_k1 is a frequent evening location, but coffee_table_l1 remains a strong candidate for other times. Do not assume a single spot. Check kitchen_table_k1, coffee_table_l1, and floor_k_k1.

book_felix: Consistently at coffee_table_l1 in the afternoon. Day 16 AM, Day 15, and Day 14 were all coffee_table_l1. Stop assuming couch_l1. Check coffee_table_l1.

mug_felix: Highly variable in late afternoon/evening. Day 21 15:50 was coffee_table_l1; Day 21 17:28 was coffee_table_l1; Day 21 18:00 was kitchen_table_k1. Previous notes suggested kitchen_table_k1 for afternoon/evening, but coffee_table_l1 is also frequent. Stop assuming cupboard_k1. Check coffee_table_l1 and kitchen_table_k1 for afternoon/evening queries.

glass_felix: Variable. Day 20 evening (21:28) was counter_k1; Day 18 evening was kitchen_table_k1; Day 16 evening was cupboard_k1. Stop assuming kitchen_table_k1 is the primary evening spot. Check counter_k1, kitchen_table_k1, and cupboard_k1 in the evening.

razor_felix: Persistent morning error. Assumed medicine_cabinet_ba1 on Day 20; actually at bathroom_shelf_ba1 on Day 20, 15, 14, 13, and 7. Stop checking medicine_cabinet_ba1 or sink_ba_ba1 for morning queries; check bathroom_shelf_ba1.

water_bottle_felix: Persistent afternoon error. Assumed dish_rack_k1; actually at coffee_table_l1 on Day 18 (09:54), Day 15, and Day 14. Stop checking dish_rack_k1 or entry_floor_e1. Check coffee_table_l1 for water bottles in the morning/afternoon.
